title: Preview the official installation flow for a supported external integration

tool.description: The plugin to preview, by its plugin-catalog id (@nx-archweave/integrations plugin-catalog.ts). The enum is kept equal to the catalog by a test.

target.description: The host environment to target. Hosts with a plugin adapter; today only 'claude-code'.

scope.description: Claude Code plugin scope shown in the previewed install command (default project: recorded in the workspace's .claude/settings.json). Only an explicit value is carried into the install-integration hint.

versionRange.description: Version to show as requested. Without it, the preview says the marketplace decides — it installs its own latest. No network access.

dryRun.description: Always previews only — no installer, file, or manifest write ever occurs, regardless of this value.
